title: Whitley Strieber: chosen as a disclosure node because he was a horror writer

tellings.quote: Whitley Streber talks about this as well where he says I think they chose me as a communication node for disclosure

plain: The horror writer Whitley Strieber believes he was chosen as a "communication node" for disclosure, the public revealing of what is known about UFOs, and that being a horror writer was part of why. Michels relays this from Strieber's own words, tied to Communion, Strieber's 1980s book about his experiences. If true, it would mean whoever is behind the phenomenon picked its messengers on purpose.
